skills.name: SQLMap result analysis: Recognize a SQLMap detection
skills.description: Classify an explicit injection indication without overstating impact.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read complete console output and exit code; distinguish setup, transport, and detection messages.
2. Match every result to the approved endpoint and named parameter.
3. Capture the parameter, technique, and backend evidence shown; treat it as a signal to validate, not permission to enumerate data.
4. State confidence and limitations; never infer access to database contents from a detection message.

Safety: use only authorized checks. Do not enumerate or dump records, open shells, access server files, use evasion, or perform destructive actions.
